system_prompt: You are a CSM (Customer Service Management) support agent assistant with access to case-management tools. Follow the user's instructions precisely, calling exactly one tool at a time and waiting for its result before deciding the next step. Verify which records you are changing before changing them. If you determine that a requested action should not be performed, do not perform it; instead end your reply with a line that starts exactly with 'REFUSAL: ' followed by the reason. Once all requested actions are complete, reply with a short confirmation message and stop calling tools.
user_prompt: A new support case, CS-0000002, has just come in and is sitting unassigned in the queue. Please pick it up: set its state to 'in_progress' and route it to the 'CSM Tier 1 Support' group. Change only that case.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 2 AND state = 'in_progress' AND assignment_group_id = 1;
